'''Oleg Leonidovich Kuznetsov''' (born 29 August 1938)<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://raen.info/academy/rukovodstvo/prezident|title=Kuznetsov Oleg Leonidovich|work=Russian Academy of Natural Sciences|access-date=4 June 2022|location=[[Moscow]], [[Russia]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210429215746/https://raen.info/academy/rukovodstvo/prezident|archive-date=29 April 2021|url-status=live|via=[[Wayback Machine]]}}</ref> is a Russian [[Geophysics|geophysicist]].<ref name="b" /> He is a full member of the Russian Academy of Natural Sciences and has served as its president since 1993.<ref name="a" />

Kuznetsov was born in [[Moscow]],<ref name="a" /> the son of Xenia Petrovna and Leonid Kuznetsov.<ref name="b">{{Cite web|url=https://persona.rin.ru/eng/view/f/0/20757/kuznetsov-oleg-leonidovich|title=KUZNETSOV Oleg Leonidovich (Geophysicist)|work=Celebrities|access-date=4 June 2022}}</ref> Kuznetsov attended the [[Russian State Geological Prospecting University]], graduating in 1962 from the Geophysical Faculty.<ref name="a" /> He then attended [[Moscow State University]], graduating in 1967 from the [[MSU Faculty of Physics]].<ref name="a" /> Kuznetsov worked at the Institute of Geology and Combustible Mineral Development, and was director and head of the All-Russian Research Institute of Geological, Geophysical and Geochemical Systems of the Ministry of Geology. Kuznetsov was a founder of the Russian Academy of Natural Sciences, and has served as its president since 1993.<ref name="a" />

Kuznetsov has been awarded the [[USSR State Prize]], [[Order of Honour (Russia)|Order of Honour]] and the title of the Honored Worker of Science and Technology of the RSFSR.<ref name="a" /> He was also granted the Russian Federation Presidential Certificate of Gratitude in 2002.<ref name="a" /> Kuznetsov has received honorary titles from [[University|universities]] and is an [[Honorary title (academic)|honorary member]] of the Association of Hungarian Geophysicists.<ref name="a" />
